description: The plots illustrate Word Error Rate (WER) during fine-tuning of a Whisper model with different amounts of weights. The x-axis is labeled “epoch”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 8, and has tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “WER”, has a linear scale, ranges from 10 to 70, and has tick labels at integer values. The first line, colored black with triangle markers, starts at approximately 68 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 45 WER at epoch 8. The second line, colored blue with circle markers, begins at approximately 62 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 40 WER at epoch 8. The third line, colored green with square markers, starts at approximately 65 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 42 WER at epoch 8. The fourth line, colored magenta with diamond markers, begins at approximately 65 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 40 WER at epoch 8.
